title: RollerCoaster Tycoon 3: Complete Edition
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#993, 2026-11-05), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.25, engine x64-crossover26.3-r28, D3DMetal, rated 3 of 5 after 9 minutes: the Epic copy. The sound runs slow, the animated rollercoaster isn't drawn, the game lags, and loading takes a minute or two. The same with WineD3D. On the Wine 10 engine it slows to a crawl before the legal screen. The environment had ROSETTA_X87_PATH set, which Highball 0.10.25 drops. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#993 (2026-11-06), on a Wine 11 engine with athei's x87sidecar on (HB_X87SIDECAR=1, which only r30 and r31 carry): the sound is right and the game is snappy. A placed coaster is still drawn as grey mush.
notes: Playable in one report on an M1, the Epic copy, on the Wine 11 engine with athei's x87sidecar on (HB_X87SIDECAR=1 on r30 or r31): sound and speed are fine, but a placed rollercoaster is drawn as grey mush. Without the sidecar the sound runs slow and the game lags. On the Wine 10 engine it slows to a crawl before the legal screen. The Steam release also has a native Mac version.

knownIssues.symptom: The sound runs slow and the game lags (M1, Wine 11 r28, D3DMetal and WineD3D)
knownIssues.cause: most likely x87 maths, which Rosetta runs slowly
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine r30 or r31 with HB_X87SIDECAR=1 in the environment's variables (highball-db#993, 2026-11-06, credit udance4ever)

knownIssues.symptom: A placed rollercoaster is drawn as grey mush (M1, Wine 11, D3DMetal and WineD3D)
Slows to a crawl before the legal screen on the Wine 10 engine (M1)
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine gets past it
